title: Chemical engineering of zeolites: alleviating transport limitations through hierarchical design and shaping
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00169B, Review Article

Nibras Hijazi, Anastasiya Bavykina, Irina Yarulina, Tuiana Shoinkhorova, Enrique V. Ramos-Fernandez, Jorge Gascon
This review examines multiscale strategies to alleviate diffusional limitations in zeolites, focusing on hierarchical structuring, nanozeolite synthesis, and advanced shaping techniques.
